title: Head of the Scientific Chair "Use of Satellite Data and Biodiversity" AIBSI
description:
Vos missions en quelques mots

This recruitment aligns fully with the AIBSI project strategy and supports the University of French Guiana’s ambition to position itself as a European university in the Amazon, deeply rooted in the specific challenges of its region. It aims to strengthen a site-based strategy built on the close integration of research, education, and innovation—centered on leveraging French Guiana’s biodiversity—while prioritizing a multidisciplinary approach.
The chair project also aims to help address local challenges regarding the implementation of environmental policies focused on the valorization, preservation, and conservation of biodiversity.

Profil recherché

1) Research activities
This project relies on an integrated, multidisciplinary approach combining remote sensing, in situ measurements, and environmental DNA (eDNA) analysis to study the coastal and estuarine systems of French Guiana, which are characterized by high turbidity and cloud cover. The goal is to develop or improve models to provide robust analyses of physical and biological processes. The research project is structured around two main axes.
(1) Structuring multi-source observational data. The first task involves centralizing and ensuring the interoperability of in situ physicochemical and hydrodynamic data obtained from the deployment of instrumented buoys, low-cost sensors, and eDNA sampling systems. The second task aims to map turbidity, vegetation, biofilms, and other indicators using satellite imagery (e.g., Sentinel-2, Landsat, Pléiades) as well as LiDAR and hyperspectral imagery to complement the in situ dataset. The third work package focuses on improving or developing new environmental models—based on statistical methods, AI, and data fusion—that will be calibrated and validated using in situ data, while accounting for scale transitions. (2) Analyzing hydro-morpho-sedimentary dynamics and biodiversity. Within this axis, the first task involves running hydrodynamic simulations using the previously developed models to analyze system evolution under the pressures of climate change. The second task focuses on studying fishery biodiversity and coastal habitats by integrating existing models with satellite data and eDNA analyses. A third task is dedicated to modeling the dynamics of mangrove and palm forests using imagery combined with field data to enable spatiotemporal monitoring.
The successful candidate is expected to develop and lead major projects that contribute to advancing the research areas associated with this position. Two doctoral students and approximately six interns enrolled in master's programs will join the person recruited for the chair to form a solid project team over a three-year period.
2) Teaching Activities
The training project aims to build and structure a scientific community focused on remote sensing and image processing through three distinct training approaches.
The first approach involves delivering training modules to UG students enrolled in BUT or Master’s programs, helping them master the physical principles of remote sensing, identify various onboard sensors, handle multi-source imagery, perform pre-processing, and apply thematic analysis methods.
The second approach focuses on a thematic school dedicated to data fusion. The goal is to enable Master’s and PhD students to understand the specific characteristics of data sources and the challenges of data fusion, as well as to implement advanced methods such as machine learning and deep learning.

Niveau d'études minimum requis

  • Niveau Niveau 8 Doctorat/diplômes équivalents

Compétences attendues

Strong skills in computer science, remote sensing methods, image processing (satellite, drone, LiDAR), data science, and complex systems modeling.

The application package must include:
• a CV detailing scientific and teaching experience;
• a comprehensive list of publications;
• a comprehensive list of research activities and funding obtained;
• a scientific proposal (3 to 5 pages maximum);
• a teaching proposal (3 to 5 pages maximum).

title: Manager, Finance Transformation
description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

Our Finance Transformation team is looking for a professional like you with the skills and drive to make a real difference. We partner with CFOs and finance leaders to modernize operations, strengthen governance, and unlock insights that drive profitability. We combine deep accounting expertise with innovative technology to help organizations build resilient, data-driven finance functions.

Our work focuses on optimizing core finance processes, ranging from: project & fixed asset accounting, accounts payable & accounts receivable, budgeting & forecasting, general ledger & period-end processes and financial & managerial reporting. This foundation enables us to design a future state target operating model, implement finance leading practices enabled by technology, and deliver lasting business value.

Success in this role requires comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments where priorities shift and solutions are not always clear-cut.


What you will do

  • Manage projects including large scale Finance transformation, system implementation and process improvement endeavors
  • Drive the development, review and completion of deliverables by setting clear objectives, aligning team efforts, and managing timelines and risks to ensure quality deliverables.
  • Help organizations manage risks and improve performance
  • Support the development of proposals and marketing events
  • Identify business development opportunities for Finance Transformation advisory projects
  • Work with senior KPMG leaders to enhance and integrate service offerings across Management Consulting practices
  • Manage, mentor and train Consultants and Senior Consultants within the Finance Transformation advisory practice
  • Develop relationships and partnerships with other KPMG offices


What you bring to the role

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • A CPA designation with 7–10 years of relevant experience and deep technical accounting expertise is considered an asset.
  • Proven background in an accounting or consulting firm, with client-facing responsibilities across diverse industries.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex workshops and workstreams with confidence and authority.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage client stakeholders, foster collaboration within teams, and drive delivery of project outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to clearly define issues and develop innovative, practical solutions aligned to client needs.

Providing you with the support you need to be at your best


Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity, we do what is right | Excellence, we never stop learning and improving | Courage, we think and act boldly | Together, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

title: Program Specialist Case Manager
description:
Full-Time | Everett, WA
$29.16 - $30.78/hour | Typical Schedule: Monday–Friday, Daytime Hours


Help people find stability, one step at a time!


Many people we serve are navigating homelessness, housing instability, mental health conditions, substance use disorders, legal involvement, disabilities, and other barriers to independence.


As a Program Specialist Case Manager with Bridgeways’ Social and Community Services (SCS) programs, you’ll provide flexible case management, outreach, service coordination, and individualized support. Depending on organizational needs and your qualifications, assignments may include supportive housing, supported employment, community outreach, diversion services, rental assistance, jail transition services, psychosocial rehabilitation, and other community-based supports. Orientation and training are provided for each assignment.


This role is for someone with sound independent judgment, strong professional boundaries, and consistent follow-through, who can support clients with complex needs. You’ll share knowledge with peers and help improve services while staying accountable to program leadership. This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.


What you’ll do:

Cross-program coverage and service continuity:

  • Provide direct services across SCS programs, including coverage during absences.
  • Follow each program’s procedures and documentation rules.
  • Coordinate caseload handoffs with Program Managers and teammates.
  • Keep reliable attendance and meet scheduling needs.


Individualized case management and client progress:

  • Develop and update individualized service plans.
  • Provide outreach, referrals, and supportive counseling using Motivational Interviewing.
  • Manage your caseload and track client progress.
  • Support clients with complex needs and keep professional boundaries.
  • Provide crisis intervention, safety assessment, and referrals.


Community partnerships, referrals, and advocacy:

  • Coordinate services with healthcare, housing, social service, employment, and legal-system partners.
  • Advocate for client rights and informed decision-making.
  • Educate clients on resources, benefits, and housing rights.
  • Help clients obtain documents for benefits and eligibility.
  • Represent Bridgeways in outreach and community meetings.


Documentation, compliance, and service accountability:

  • Keep accurate, timely, and confidential records.
  • Enter data into HMIS, Credible (our EMR), and other program systems.
  • Meet documentation, funding, contract, and productivity requirements.
  • Protect health information under HIPAA.
  • Follow policies on client rights, mandated reporting, and field safety.
  • Report client needs and safety concerns to the right people.


Practice support and continuous improvement:

  • Provide culturally responsive, trauma-informed, person-centered services.
  • Share knowledge with peers and help orient new staff.
  • Join case consultations, team meetings, supervision, and training.
  • Recommend fixes for recurring service barriers.
  • Model our core values: Integrity, Positivity, Resiliency, and Responsibility.


Schedule & location:

This is a full-time position with a typical with a typical Monday–Friday daytime schedule, generally between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., with some flexibility based on personal, client, and program needs.


Your home office will be Everett, WA, with regular travel to client residences, community agencies, and other service sites.


Company vehicles are available for work-related travel for employees meeting Bridgeways’ driving requirements.


Pay & benefits: $29.16 - $30.78 per hour


Bridgeways offers comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Up to 31 paid days off for new employees: 15 flexible-use PTO days, 10 paid holidays, 2 personal days, and a paid year-end closure.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with medical premiums starting as low as $39 biweekly for eligible employees.
  • Optional Life, Critical Illness, Accident, and pet insurance.
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting, plus an employer contribution equal to 3% of gross wages after one year of service.

100% Employer-Paid Benefits:

  • Mental health coverage through Teladoc Mental Health, including access to therapists and psychiatrists.
  • Roadside Assistance for all employees.
  • Long-term disability for eligible employees.
  • Vision, prescription, and entertainment discount programs.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

We are seeking a DevSecOps Engineer to support enterprise DevSecOps platforms, cloud-native technologies, application security, developer enablement, and software delivery automation. The role focuses on CI/CD platform operations, Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure support, API management, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), security integration, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement across the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC).


What you will do

  • Application Security: Support application security practices throughout the SSDLC, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management, vulnerability management, secure coding initiatives, and remediation coordination
  • Source Code Management & CI/CD: Administer Azure DevOps (ADO) and GitHub Enterprise (GHE), including repositories, pipelines, access controls, integrations, governance, and release automation
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and support infrastructure automation using Terraform, including environment provisioning, configuration management, and deployment standardization
  • API Management: Support Azure API Management (APIM), including API onboarding, configuration, lifecycle management, security policies, governance, and troubleshooting
  • Cloud & Container Platforms: Assist with managing Azure resources, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Virtual Machines (VMs), Azure Key Vault, containerized workloads, identity management, and related cloud services
  • Developer Enablement: Provide technical support for DevSecOps platforms, CI/CD pipelines, development tooling integrations, secure development practices, and developer onboarding
  • Licensing & Vendor Management: Track software licensing, utilization, renewals, vendor support cases, escalations, and service commitments
  • Operations & Governance: Monitor platform health, support upgrades, troubleshoot incidents, maintain documentation, assist with automation initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement programs

What you bring to the role

  • 2+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Application Security, Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Platform Support, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Secure SDLC practices
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps Pipelines, including CI/CD automation
  • Experience with Git, source code repositories, and branching strategies
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized applications, and cloud-native technologies
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts and tools such as Terraform
  • Understanding of application security concepts and practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management, and vulnerability management
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services, including AKS, Key Vault, API Management, and identity and access management concepts
  • Basic scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash, with an interest in leveraging automation to improve engineering and operational processes
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess technical issues and identify practical solutions
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with a customer-focused approach to developer support and enablement
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, cybersecurity teams, platform engineers, vendors, and other stakeholders
  • A continuous-learning mindset with an interest in emerging technologies and improving operational processes
  • Experience supporting enterprise DevSecOps platforms and developer tools
  • Familiarity with API security, REST APIs, software supply chain security, and cloud security principles
  • Exposure to AI-assisted software development, automation, and operational tooling
  • Knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, secure coding practices, and enterprise governance frameworks would be an asset
  • Experience with software licensing, vendor coordination, or ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow would be beneficial
  • Relevant certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, GitHub, Terraform, or DevOps would be considered an asset

This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate will be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders nationally in our English speaking provinces while at KPMG.

KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $74,000 to $111,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

KPMG NB Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $74,000 to $111,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.


Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity, we do what is right | Excellence, we never stop learning and improving | Courage, we think and act boldly | Together, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.

title: Service Inspector
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Service Technicians perform inspection and repair of cargo tanks transporting hazardous materials. West-Mark Service Centers are National Board Certified and require team member skills in welding, vehicle mechanics, hydraulics, electrical, etc.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

1. Repair and Service Functions

1.1. Receives Instructions, prints and work orders.

1.2. Fabricate components as required by cutting, burning, and welding various metals.

1.3. Assembles small and large assemblies to drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.

1.4. Finishing tasks including basic electrical, plumbing, hydraulics, and safety systems

1.5. Properly documents time and material used on jobs.

1.6. Diagnose, repair and install all standard components and systems.

1.7. Can read, understand, modify specifications, drawings, bill of materials, and testing documentation.


2. Testing and Certification

2.1. Understands basic industry rules and regulations including DOT, HM180, 3A, NFPA, etc.

2.2. Certified for tank preparation, tank entry, forklift, and other required safety qualifications.


3. Material Handling

3.1. Proper part identification including raw material sheet and shape.

3.2. Certified Forklift Operator and trained crane operator

3.3. Move and safely handle trailers, parts and material in shop and yard.


4. Equipment Operation

4.1. Proper use and maintenance of welders

4.2. Proper use of hand tools, drills, grinders, impact guns

4.3. Proper use of cranes

4.4. Proper use of shop machinery & equipment (as required by work area assignment)
